messages:
alex_k: Heads up — planning to deploy users table partitioning + email index swap tomorrow 02:00 UTC. This will require a dual-write window and a parallel backfill. Who can own the deploy?
maria_s: I can own deploy + smoke. Available for the 02:00 UTC slot.
chris: Rough backfill size? any estimates on runtime with parallel workers?
maria_s: ~150M rows total for users. With 8 workers we expect ~2.5–3h. Single-threaded would be 10–12h, so we need parallel. We'll shard by user_id ranges.
tiffany: We should do online migration (gh-ost / pg_repack style) to avoid locks — agree to dual-write for ~3h?
alex_k: Product ok with short dual-write window?
kevin_pm: Product ok with 3h dual-write. Need clear smoke criteria and rollback plan.
maria_s: Deploy checklist (high level):
1) Create new partitions and indexes concurrently on replica.
2) Deploy app change behind feature flag (dual-write ON).
3) Start backfill script: `./infra/backfills/backfill_users_partitions.sh --workers=8 --batch=2000`
4) Run smoke checks (login, profile edit, sample reconcile queries).
5) Monitor p50/p95 latency, 5xxs, replication lag.
6) Flip read traffic to partitioned tables after reconciliation.
7) Remove dual-write and cleanup after 24h.

chris: If backfill runs into problematic rows (bad emails / malformed JSON), what's the plan?
maria_s: We'll log and skip problem batches, mark for manual review. If it's systemic we'll pause backfill, disable dual-write, and investigate. For severe corruption we'll restore from PITR snapshot (RTO ~30m) — but that is last resort.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline: all checks green; canary passed in staging.
alex_k: Can someone paste the exact smoke SQL queries we'll run post-backfill? Need them in runbook.
maria_s: Paste below.
maria_s: ```sql
-- quick smoke checks after backfill
SELECT count(1) FROM users_part_2026 WHERE email IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1;
SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = 42; -- known test user
-- reconcile snippet (should be zero)
SELECT count(1) FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users_part p WHERE p.id = u.id);
```
chris: Add alert thresholds: replication lag > 30s, 5xx rate +200% over baseline, p95 latency +50%.
tiffany: We'll build indexes concurrently ahead of time on the new partitions so switch is fast. I'll post exact `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` commands.
kevin_pm: Tagging infra on-call: @eng-infra please standby 01:30–06:00 UTC for this work.
eng-infra: I'm on-call 01:30–05:00 UTC; can extend if needed — ping me 30m before rolling.
alex_k: Rollback plan (short):
- If backfill stalls or causes regressions: stop backfill, keep dual-write on, disable new read path (app flag), revert app deploy if needed.
- If data corruption suspected: take DB off write path, analyze, and restore latest PITR snapshot.
- Post-mortem + follow-up migration if we need targeted fixes.

maria_s: We'll also include a lightweight reconcile job after backfill to confirm parity for a sample range.
chris: Who will run the backfill CLI and monitor logs?
maria_s: I'll kick it off and tail logs. @tiffany will watch index builds and p99 latency.
ale x_k: small correction: start dual-write at 02:10 (give deploy 10m to roll), backfill begin 02:15. Expected finish ~05:30, flip reads ~05:45, cleanup after 24h.
maria_s: sounds good — I'll draft a short runbook and paste link here before EOD. :thumbsup:
chris: +1
tiffany: +1 — will monitor index creation.
kevin_pm: I'll create calendar invite for the window and add product owners.
alex_k: Thanks. Final: deploy at 02:00 UTC, dual-write 02:10, backfill 02:15. Any last blockers?
maria_s: none from infra or data side.
eng-infra: No blockers, will be available.
alex_k: I'll post runbook link here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/users-partition-migration (will update with smoke commands).
kevin_pm: thanks everyone — ping if plan changes.
__note: No title field included per agents.md. Messages are a single continuous Slack thread string with messages prefixed by sender name.
